sloka: ततो मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना किं नाम गगने मम ।ईदृशो विघ्न उत्पन्नो रूपं यत्र न दृश्यते ।। ५.५८.३६ ।।।।
transliteration: tato me buddhirutpannā kiṁ nāma gagane mama ।īdṛśo vighna utpanno rūpaṁ yatra na dṛśyate ।। 5.58.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the thought arose in me: who is this in the sky, and what strange obstacle has arisen here, in which no form can be seen?
